overview: 今日专题“气候、环境与公共安全”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: Queensland and NT reject Labor’s push to ensure that power-hungry AI datacentres use renewable energy
items.summary: Federal-state stoush comes as rating agency warns that electricity bills could skyrocket Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Queensland and the Northern Territory have rejected the federal government’s plans to mandate that AI datacentres use renewable power, rubbishing Anthony Albanese’s proposals to regulate the booming technology as “underdeveloped ideas that hand increased power to Canberra”. The latest federal-state stoush on energy comes as S&P Global, the economic rating agency, warns that power use from datacentres could rise five-fold by 2035 to 10% of Australia’s total consumption, and that a mismatch between delivery timelines for datacentres and renewable projects could lead to energy bills skyrocketing. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 昆士兰州和北领地拒绝工党关于强制AI数据中心使用可再生能源的提议
items.summaryZh: 昆士兰州和北领地政府拒绝了联邦政府强制AI数据中心使用可再生能源的计划，认为该提议不成熟且过度集权。评级机构标普全球警告称，到2035年数据中心用电量可能激增至澳大利亚总用电量的10%，若能源供应跟不上，电费恐将大幅上涨。
items.whyImportant: 此举凸显了澳大利亚联邦与地方政府在能源政策及AI基础设施监管方面的分歧。

The meeting is expected to be much more cordial than the one last year where Trump openly berated Zelenskyy and said, “you don’t have the cards”. The administration and rightwing influencers have shown a shift on Ukraine as of late, and Trump and Zelenskyy had a friendly meeting at a Nato summit earlier this month. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 美国参议院投票推进俄罗斯制裁法案，该法案将赋予特朗普新的关税权力
items.summaryZh: 尽管参议院以86票对12票通过了该法案，但有民主党助手警告称，法案赋予了总统过大的豁免制裁和征收关税的自由裁量权。此外，特朗普与乌克兰总统泽连斯基的会晤将不对媒体开放，双方关系近期有所缓和。
items.whyImportant: 该法案的推进可能显著扩大美国总统在国际贸易和外交制裁方面的行政权力。

items.title: ‘Race against time’: Japan earthquake death toll rises as rescue teams search for missing
items.summary: Military mobilises thousands of personnel after quake on southern Kyushu island that registered a maximum 7 on the Japanese shindo intensity scale At least 13 people were killed when a 6.8 magnitude earthquake struck southern Japan on Tuesday, injuring hundreds and knocking out power and water to tens of thousands. “There are people who are still waiting to be rescued, and it’s a race against time,” the prime minister, Sanae Takaichi, said on Wednesday. “We will go all out to find and rescue as many people as we can.” Continue reading...
items.titleZh: “与时间赛跑”：日本地震死亡人数上升，救援队搜寻失踪者
items.summaryZh: 日本九州岛南部发生6.8级地震，已造成至少13人死亡，数百人受伤，数万人断水断电。日本首相高市早苗表示，救援工作正在与时间赛跑，政府将全力搜救失踪人员。
items.whyImportant: 此次强震对日本南部基础设施造成严重破坏，救援行动的成效直接影响灾区恢复速度。

items.title: Japan quake death toll rises to 13 after newly reopened Aeon Mall collapses
items.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said 13 people have been found dead after a powerful quake shook part of southwestern Japan and rescue work was continuing Wednesday morning for the missing. A magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck the Kumamoto area on the southern main island of Kyushu late on Tuesday afternoon. “There are people who are still waiting to be rescued, and it’s a race against time,” Takaichi said. “We will go all out to find and rescue as many people as we can.” Takaichi offered...
items.titleZh: 日本地震死亡人数升至13人，新开业的永旺梦乐城发生坍塌
items.summaryZh: 日本九州熊本地区发生7.1级地震，目前已确认13人死亡，救援人员仍在搜寻失踪者。首相高市早苗强调，政府将竭尽全力进行救援，目前搜救工作仍在持续进行中。
items.whyImportant: 大型商业设施的坍塌加剧了地震灾害的严重性，引发了对建筑安全标准的关注。

items.title: Daniel Andrews says Ben Carroll ‘can win’ Victoria election in rare public statement
items.summary: Former leader shows support for new Victorian premier while paying tribute to Jacinta Allan Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Former premier Daniel Andrews has thrown his support behind Victoria’s new Labor leader, Ben Carroll, saying he has what it takes to win November’s state election. In a rare public statement on Wednesday, Andrews also paid tribute to Jacinta Allan, who he handpicked to replace him as premier when he resigned in September 2023. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 丹尼尔·安德鲁斯罕见发表公开声明，称本·卡罗尔“有能力赢得”维多利亚州选举
items.summaryZh: 前维多利亚州州长丹尼尔·安德鲁斯公开支持新任工党领袖本·卡罗尔，认为他有能力赢得11月的州选举。安德鲁斯同时对继任者杰辛塔·艾伦表示了敬意。
items.whyImportant: 前州长的公开背书对维多利亚州工党在即将到来的选举中的士气具有重要影响。

items.titleZh: 以色列在加沙杀害一名巴勒斯坦人并摧毁一座清真寺
items.summaryZh: 以色列军队在加沙地区采取行动，导致一名巴勒斯坦人死亡并摧毁了一座清真寺。与此同时，以色列定居者在被占领的约旦河西岸伯利恒袭击了一个巴勒斯坦家庭。
items.whyImportant: 此类暴力事件进一步加剧了巴以地区的紧张局势和人道主义危机。

items.summary: Riyadh says its targeted attacks were done in coordination with the US military.
items.titleZh: 沙特阿拉伯与美国对伊拉克境内的伊朗支持组织发动袭击
items.summaryZh: 沙特阿拉伯宣布，其针对伊拉克境内目标的袭击是与美国军方协调进行的。此次行动旨在打击伊朗支持的武装组织。
items.whyImportant: 沙特与美国的联合军事行动标志着中东地区针对伊朗代理人势力的军事压力升级。

items.title: 【熊本県まとめ】3人死亡 5人心肺停止 少なくとも7人安否不明
items.summary: 熊本県によりますと、今回の地震では29日午前9時半の時点で、3人が死亡し5人が心肺停止、31人がけがをしたほか、安否不明となっている人が少なくとも7人いるということです。
items.titleZh: 【熊本县总结】3人死亡，5人心肺停止，至少7人下落不明
items.summaryZh: 据熊本县统计，截至29日上午9点半，地震已造成3人死亡，5人心肺停止，31人受伤。目前仍有至少7人下落不明。
items.whyImportant: 伤亡数据的更新反映了地震灾情的严重程度，救援工作的紧迫性进一步提升。

items.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻直播：ICAC听取关于前新南威尔士州自由党部长涉嫌婚外情的“丑闻清单”；警方将母子死亡案定性为谋杀-自杀
items.summaryZh: 新南威尔士州反腐败委员会（ICAC）正在调查有关前部长的丑闻。此外，一架经过特殊改装的空客A350在完成24小时创纪录测试飞行后抵达法国，该机型将于明年加入澳洲航空机队。
items.whyImportant: 政治丑闻调查与航空业的重大进展同时发生，反映了澳大利亚国内政治与经济动态。

items.title: 【29日】熊本 震度7 活動が活発 同程度の地震に1週間ほど注意
items.summary: 28日、熊本県熊本地方でマグニチュード7.1の大地震が発生して熊本県の宇城市と氷川町で震度7の揺れを観測し、熊本県では大きな被害が出ています。その後も震度5弱を観測する地震が3回発生するなど地震活動が活発になっていて、気象庁は今後、1週間ほどは最大震度7程度の地震に注意するよう呼びかけています。熊本県では29日、猛烈な暑さが予想されていて、復旧作業などの際は熱中症対策を心がけてください。
items.titleZh: 【29日】熊本发生震度7地震，地震活动活跃，未来一周需警惕同级别地震
items.summaryZh: 熊本县28日发生7.1级大地震，宇城市和冰川町观测到震度7的剧烈摇晃。气象厅警告称地震活动依然活跃，未来一周内仍需警惕发生同级别地震，并提醒民众在高温天气下注意防暑。
items.whyImportant: 持续的余震风险和极端天气给灾区救援和民众生活带来了双重挑战。

items.title: China has 6 of world’s 10 most innovative humanoid robot start-ups: report
items.summary: China is widening its lead over the United States in the race to develop humanoid robots, with Chinese firms accounting for six of the world’s 10 most innovative start-ups in the sector, according to a new report tracking global patent data, as Washington moves to restrict imports of robots, including those made in China. Firms from China dominated the ranking released by legal research platform LexisNexis on Tuesday, claiming a clean sweep of the top five. The top five places went to...
items.titleZh: 报告：全球十大最具创新力的人形机器人初创公司中，中国占据六席
items.summaryZh: 根据LexisNexis的最新报告，中国在人形机器人研发领域领先美国，全球十大最具创新力的初创公司中中国占六席，且包揽了前五名。尽管华盛顿试图限制包括中国制造在内的机器人进口，但中国企业的创新优势依然显著。
items.whyImportant: 中国在人形机器人领域的领先地位可能引发中美在高端制造业和科技领域的进一步竞争。

items.title: Independent bookshop of 50 years to close after national security raid
items.summary: A 50-year-old independent bookshop has announced it will close when its lease ends, following a raid by Hong Kong national security police earlier this month. Greenfield Book Store, located on Sai Yeung Choi Street in Mong Kok, took to social media during the early hours of Wednesday morning to announce its plans to close. “The shop will close down after the end of the lease. Thank you, everyone, for your support over the past 50 years since the shop opened. Thank you and take care,” the...
items.titleZh: 经营50年的独立书店在国安搜查后宣布结业
items.summaryZh: 位于香港旺角的绿野仙踪书店在经历本月初的国安警察搜查后，宣布将在租约期满后结业。书店通过社交媒体感谢了顾客过去50年的支持。
items.whyImportant: 该书店的结业反映了香港社会文化空间在当前政治环境下的变化。

items.title: HSBC to relocate senior executive to Hong Kong amid pivot to Asia: sources
items.summary: HSBC Holdings will relocate its group chief people and governance officer, Aileen Taylor, from London to Hong Kong later this year, as the lender doubles down on expanding its Hong Kong and Asia operations, according to sources at the bank. A source told the South China Morning Post that an internal decision to relocate Taylor to Hong Kong had already been made, as part of a push to strengthen the presence of senior executives in Hong Kong – HSBC’s biggest market and its focus of...
items.titleZh: 消息人士：汇丰银行将把一名高级主管调往香港，以加强亚洲业务
items.summaryZh: 据知情人士透露，汇丰银行计划将集团首席人力与治理官艾琳·泰勒从伦敦调往香港。此举是汇丰银行深耕香港及亚洲市场战略的一部分，旨在加强高管在核心市场的存在感。
items.whyImportant: 汇丰高管的调动显示了该行进一步向亚洲市场倾斜的战略重心。

items.title: How Hong Kong can chart a cycle-friendly course
items.summary: During the opening ceremony of Ride to Shine Hong Kong this month, Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law Shuk-pui challenged Hongkongers to cycle more than 1.2 million km – a distance equivalent to circling the Earth 30 times – to commemorate Hong Kong’s 30th anniversary of returning to China next year. Cycling is more than a trend and worth developing. Since the invention of the bicycle, it has been the most energy-efficient form of human-powered transport – including running or...
items.titleZh: 香港如何规划自行车友好型城市
items.summaryZh: 香港文化体育及旅游局局长杨润雄近期发起骑行挑战，纪念香港回归祖国30周年。文章指出，自行车作为高效的交通工具，值得在香港进一步推广和发展。
items.whyImportant: 推动自行车友好型城市建设有助于提升香港的城市交通效率和可持续发展水平。

items.title: AI boom will sustain Hong Kong’s export surge, lift GDP outlook, economists say
items.summary: Hong Kong’s export surge will extend into the coming months, driven by the global AI boom, economists have told the South China Morning Post, adding that gross domestic product (GDP) growth could surpass official forecasts. Billy Mak Sui-choi, an associate professor at Baptist University’s accountancy, economics and finance department, said global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) remained far from saturated and would continue to drive exports. “No single country has yet been able to...
items.titleZh: 经济学家：AI热潮将持续推动香港出口增长，提升GDP预期
items.summaryZh: 经济学家表示，受全球AI热潮驱动，香港出口增长将持续，GDP增长可能超过官方预期。专家指出，全球对AI的需求远未饱和，将继续支撑香港的出口表现。
items.whyImportant: AI产业的全球需求成为香港经济复苏和增长的重要引擎。

items.title: US thwarts Iranian missile barrage, joins Saudis in Iraq strikes
items.summary: The US military said Tuesday that it knocked down an Iranian missile barrage and worked with Saudi forces to strike sites in Iraq that Tehran-backed militias used to launch attacks in recent days, shattering a brief pause in the fighting. All Iranian missiles launched against American forces in the Middle East were intercepted, US Central Command said, adding that they “remain vigilant and at a high state of readiness”. In announcing the strikes in Iraq, the US warned that further attacks on...
items.titleZh: 美国挫败伊朗导弹袭击，并与沙特联合对伊拉克发动打击
items.summaryZh: 美国军方周二拦截了伊朗发射的弹道导弹，并与沙特军队合作，打击了伊拉克境内伊朗支持的民兵组织据点。此次行动打破了短暂的停火，美国警告称将对进一步袭击采取反制措施。
items.whyImportant: 美伊直接军事对抗的升级加剧了中东地区爆发更大规模冲突的风险。

items.title: Trump praises back-to-back meetings with Zelenskyy and Netanyahu
items.summary: US president makes positive posts as Ukraine seeks more firepower and Israeli PM seeks to repair relationship Donald Trump hosted back-to-back White House meetings with Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Benjamin Netanyahu on Tuesday, as Ukraine seeks more firepower for its air defenses and the Israeli prime minister tries to repair his strained relationship with the US president. Trump described both meetings in positive terms on social media Tuesday evening, remaining vague about what was discussed. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普称赞与泽连斯基和内塔尼亚胡的连续会晤
items.summaryZh: 特朗普周二在白宫先后会见了乌克兰总统泽连斯基和以色列总理内塔尼亚胡。特朗普在社交媒体上对会晤给予了积极评价，但未透露具体讨论内容。
items.whyImportant: 特朗普与这两位关键盟友的会晤，对美国在乌克兰和中东的外交政策走向具有重要意义。

items.title: Trump mourns Lindsey Graham as war hawk, golfing buddy at Washington funeral
items.summary: US President Donald Trump eulogised Republican Senator Lindsey Graham on Tuesday as a fixture of national politics and unflinching foreign policy hawk, as the leaders of Israel and Ukraine joined Washington’s most powerful at his funeral. Earlier in the day, lawmakers paid tribute at the Capitol Rotunda, remembering one of the last prominent Republicans to advocate for muscular US military power abroad as gregarious, funny and persuasive. “He was extremely hawkish – he never saw a war that he...
items.titleZh: 特朗普在华盛顿葬礼上悼念林赛·格雷厄姆，称其为战争鹰派和高尔夫球友
items.summaryZh: 特朗普在共和党参议员林赛·格雷厄姆的葬礼上致悼词，称赞其为坚定的外交政策鹰派。以色列和乌克兰领导人也出席了葬礼，向这位主张美国强硬军事力量的政治人物致敬。
items.whyImportant: 格雷厄姆的离世标志着美国共和党内传统鹰派力量的缺失，引发了对其外交遗产的讨论。

items.title: Record Chinese biotech out-licensing meets rising US scrutiny
items.summary: China’s emergence as a global biotechnology innovation hub has become a source of strategic concern in the United States, prompting policymakers in Washington to re-evaluate how to respond to its growing influence, according to a recent report by a leading analytics firm. “The country’s latest biotechnology success is strategically important, with implications extending beyond healthcare innovation to include pharmaceutical supply-chain resilience, economic competitiveness and national...
items.titleZh: 中国生物技术授权出海面临美国日益严格的审查
items.summaryZh: 报告显示，中国作为全球生物技术创新中心的崛起引发了美国的战略担忧。华盛顿正在重新评估如何应对中国在医疗创新、供应链韧性及经济竞争力方面的影响力。
items.whyImportant: 生物技术领域的竞争已成为中美科技博弈和国家安全考量的新焦点。

items.title: Media not invited as Trump, Netanyahu hold talks at the White House
items.summary: US President Donald Trump has held talks at the White House with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
items.titleZh: 特朗普与内塔尼亚胡在白宫举行会谈，媒体未获邀请
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普在白宫与以色列总理内塔尼亚胡举行了会谈。此次会晤未邀请媒体参加。
items.whyImportant: 闭门会谈引发了外界对美以两国在关键地区议题上达成秘密共识的猜测。

items.title: イオンモール熊本で爆発 警察が映像公開 2人死亡1人心肺停止

items.titleZh: 永旺梦乐城熊本发生爆炸，警方公布影像，2人死亡1人心肺停止

items.summaryZh: 美国中央司令部表示，已拦截了伊朗发射的“多枚”弹道导弹。此次交火打破了双方此前短暂的平静。
items.whyImportant: 美伊冲突的反复升级增加了地区局势失控的可能性。

items.title: Japan earthquake: What we know so far

items.titleZh: 日本地震：目前已知的情况
